ChurchTransaction.title: ChurchTransaction
ChurchTransaction.description: Represents a cash inflow or outflow in the church treasury

userId.description: UID of the church treasurer or parish leader managing the record

category.description: Category: DIME, OFFRANDE, DON, QUETE_SPECIALE, ACTION_GRACE, TRAVAUX, SOCIAL, FACTURE, CULTE, MISSION, AUTRE

paymentMethod.description: Payment channel: ESPECES, MOBILE_MONEY, BANQUE, CHEQUE, AUTRE

serviceType.description: Service or event: CULTE_DIMANCHE, CULTE_SEMAINE, VEILLEE, EVENEMENT_SPECIAL, AUTRE

donorOrRecipient.description: Optional name of donor (for tithe/gift) or recipient (for expense)

note.description: Detailed remarks or description of transaction

referenceNumber.description: Receipt or voucher or mobile transaction reference

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of creation. Clients must supply FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last update. Clients must supply FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/transactions/{transactio.description: Collection of treasury transactions scoped strictly to the church manager
